items.title: Gene Munster Says iPhone 18 Pre-Order Wait Times Are Climbing, Calls It a 'Favorable Sign for Demand'
items.summary: Deepwater Asset Management’s Gene Munster said Monday that Apple Inc.’s (NASDAQ:AAPL) iPhone 18 pre-order wait times have climbed sharply since the weekend, a trend he calls an early, favorable signal of demand across major markets worldwide.
